desc.zh: 按副本计数，扩展覆盖后收缩，推导线性最小窗口。
desc.en: Count required copies, expand to cover, then shrink to derive a linear minimum-window scan.

complexity: O(m+n) time; O(k) auxiliary space, k≤52; O(L) output

concepts.name: Covering by multiplicity
concepts.description: A contiguous window must supply every requested copy.

concepts.name: Missing-copy invariant
concepts.description: Maintain the sum of positive count deficits using threshold crossings.

concepts.name: Monotone window boundaries
concepts.description: Discarded starts cannot improve the recorded answer at later right edges.
